description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for a Text-to-Speech (TTS) speaker component, including configuration, speech data management, and GStreamer pipeline handling.

classes.name: TTSSpeakerClient
classes.description: Interface for TTS client callbacks related to speech events.

classes.name: SpeechData
classes.description: Structure holding information about a speech request.

classes.name: TTSSpeaker
classes.description: Main class managing TTS speech synthesis, pipeline, and queue.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::ensurePipeline
methods.description: Ensures the GStreamer pipeline is created and ready.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::isSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if a speech with given ID is currently speaking.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::getSpeechState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a speech.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::reset
methods.description: Resets the TTS system, clearing queues and resetting pipeline.

methods.name: TTSSpeaker::getPipelineType
methods.description: Returns the current pipeline type (MP3 or PCM).
